Text to PDF

Turn plain text into a clean, printable A4 PDF. Add a title, pick a font size, and your text is wrapped automatically across as many pages as needed.

Text to PDF

Type or paste text and get a clean, printable A4 PDF.

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text into the box.
  2. Optionally add a document title and choose a font size.
  3. Click "Create PDF".
  4. The A4 PDF downloads automatically, with long text flowing onto extra pages.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What if my text is longer than one page?

As many as it takes. Long text flows onto additional A4 pages automatically with the same margins and formatting.

Which font is used in the PDF?

The PDF uses the standard Helvetica typeface, which prints cleanly on any device and needs no special fonts installed.

Is my text uploaded to a server?

Your text stays in your browser. The PDF is generated locally and nothing is uploaded anywhere.
